title: The Crayons Gathered after the Class
youtube_title: The Crayons Gathered after the Class | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness leaves a person with their dignity intact.
summary: At a school hallway of pegs, stools, and music stands, a crayons left like bright sticks on the floor is awkward for one person. Opal notices Neighbor Sami struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
